verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit docs explicitly state suggested code changes can be applied directly to the PR with a single click ('Apply suggested changes directly to your PR with a single click—no copy-paste, no switching contexts') and that it generates fix code, not just identifies issues, corroborated by one-click agentic actions to fix findings. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation specifically of the one-click commit UX (community evidence covers general review quality, not this specific diff-apply feature).
